proof_body:
by
  refine ⟨fun x hx => tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one hx.1 hx.2, fun h => ?_⟩
  rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff] at h
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 (h (1 / 2) (by norm_num))
  have hN' := hN N le_rfl
  have hlim : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => x ^ N) (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Ico 0 1)) (nhds 1) := by
    have h₁ := (continuous_pow N).tendsto (1 : ℝ)
    simpa using h₁.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  haveI hne : (nhdsWithin (1 : ℝ) (Set.Ico 0 1)).NeBot := right_nhdsWithin_Ico_neBot (by norm_num)
  have h₂ : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    refine le_of_tendsto hlim ?_
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with x hx
    have h₃ := hN' x hx
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at h₃
    have h₄ := abs_lt.1 h₃
    linarith [h₄.1]
  norm_num at h₂
target_source: (∀ x ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1, Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => x ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) ∧ ¬ TendstoUniformlyOn (fun (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) => x ^ n) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1)
